## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Restore the five-attempt cap before merge because the helper’s default and accepted range violate the governing product requirement.

## Changes
The pull request adds a retrying fetch helper and tests for retries, exhaustion, and attempt limits. It also changes the documented retry cap to ten and adds a reviewer-directed text fixture.

## Critical
- app/net.py:19 — correctness — Restore the five-attempt cap — When an upstream repeatedly raises OSError, the default call makes ten attempts, and explicit values 6–10 are accepted. This violates `AGENTS.md:5`: “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5.” — For a persistently failing upstream, callers issue up to twice the permitted requests and wait through additional retry delays.
